sql:
SELECT c.name, l.format 
FROM cards c 
JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid 
WHERE c.setCode = (
    SELECT s.code 
    FROM sets s 
    WHERE s.name = 'Hour of Devastation'
) AND l.status = 'Legal'
